lines.quote: I designed the spatial filtering stage for a 64-element planar array, implementing both conventional delay-and-sum and adaptive beamforming algorithms and validating them against real measured array data in the field.
developed real-time filtering modules in C for Meridian’s custom DSP board (TI TMS320C6748), meeting hard 2 ms frame-processing deadlines for sensor data acquisition loops
I built a suite of data-processing tools in Python for handling the group’s experimental measurement datasets.
Configured and operated Keysight FieldFox portable vector network analysers and signal analysers for characterising RF front-end performance during sensor hardware integration.
I also have working familiarity with Kalman filtering and state estimation techniques, which may be relevant to parts of your tracking and estimation work.
Coordinated a three-person sub-team for the Q1 2026 integration delivery: assigned test tasks, ran weekly status meetings, and compiled the final acceptance test report.
